title: HTGChat
description: Adds commands for announcements, chat management and basic communication.
body:
# HTGChat

**Modern, efficient and feature-rich chat management system for Paper / Purpur servers.**  
Private messages, announcements, custom plugin GUI, `/plugins` protection and PlaceholderAPI integration — all in one lightweight plugin.

---

## Features

### Chat System
- Enable / disable global chat (`/chat`)
- Permission-based control
- PlaceholderAPI support
- Dynamic message formatting
- Stable performance on modern Minecraft versions

![Chat Management](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/aa4d347f5bf13081e13e6701fbdb464e11b14121.png)

---

### Private Messages
- `/msg <player> <message>`
- `/r` – quick reply
- Tab completion
- Placeholder integration

---

### Announcements
- `/ogloszenie`
- Preset system
- GUI support
- Interaction listener handling

![Announcement Panel](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/02762a01bffabf7a507475fbf617cbf71141ca03.png)

![Announcement Presets](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/cf98aa5db524c6bd75c11f9fba436c658e7f42ff.png)

---

### Plugins GUI
- Custom GUI instead of `/plugins`
- Blocks default plugin list display
- Prevents server information leaks
- Fully configurable

![Plugins List GUI](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/174fb7b475f754e2cdcd37cce0e1bca315906427.png)

---

### PlaceholderAPI Integration
- Automatic detection
- Dynamic re-hooking when enabled/disabled
- Stable reinitialization

---

## Commands

- /chat
- /hchat
- /msg
- /r
- /ogloszenie
- /pomoc


---

## Security

- `/plugins` protection
- Permission-based access control
- Prevents server infrastructure exposure
- Stable chat state management

---

## Compatibility

- Paper
- Purpur
- Minecraft 1.20+
- PlaceholderAPI (optional)

---

## Designed For

- BoxPvP  
- Survival  
- Economy  
- Custom server projects
